baselineAtZero: A uniform card grid: one span for every tile, square corners, tile background equal to the page background, media fully inset at a concentric radius, no reveal and no hover lift. Separation comes from the gap and the hairline border alone. Recognisable as plain, fully accessible, and the planner's uniform-is-not-bento check says out loud that this is a card grid rather than a bento.

spanVariance.note: Doc §13. Target largest:smallest tile-area ratio. 1.0 is a uniform card grid; 3.0 is a 2x2 hero beside 1x1 units. The closed span vocabulary quantises this into four bands, and assign-spans.mjs reports the ratio the emitted composition actually measures next to the requested one.

radius.note: Doc §13. 0px is brutalist / Live Tile; 24px is the Apple default; 32px is clay-adjacent. One value for every tile in the grid.

surfaceDelta.note: Doc §13. Luminance points between page and tile background. 0 means tiles are defined by the gap alone; 24 is strongly separated cards.

mediaBleed.note: Doc §13. How far tile media runs past the padding box. 0% is fully inset with a concentric radius; 100% is full-bleed cover.

motion.note: Doc §13. 0 is no reveal and no hover lift; 50 is a 320ms reveal with a -2px lift; 100 is a 400ms reveal, -4px lift, 1.03 media scale and per-tile parallax. Hard-clamped to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion.

contextCaps.reason: Doc §9: comparison demands equal visual weight. A larger tile reads as "recommended" whether you meant it or not.
Doc §9: three things is a card row wearing a costume.
Doc §9: a bento composition is hand-tuned. A source returning 4 items one day and 11 the next breaks it, so the layout is held near-uniform where a changing count degrades safely.
Doc §13: size encodes importance only while the eye holds the whole composition. Past nine tiles the section needs a hierarchy break before variance helps.

implementationNote: scripts/assign-spans.mjs resolves intensity inline rather than shelling out to ui-morphism-core:token-emit, because the planner needs the effective value to make span decisions in the same pass and a plan must be computable offline. Its capsFor() and segment() are the same four caps and the same anchored curves declared here, and assign-spans.test.mjs pins both against this file: it reads this JSON, resolves intensity from the anchors, clamps and contextCaps declared in it, and asserts the planner returns the same effective intensity and the same five knob values across the whole 0-100 sweep and for every cap. This contract remains the authority: when the two disagree, the planner is wrong.

clampsNotExpressibleHere.dominantTilesPerGrid: exactly 1, or 0 in the uniform and mild bands
clampsNotExpressibleHere.gutter: one value per section per breakpoint: 16px desktop, 12px below 768px, 24px editorial
clampsNotExpressibleHere.gridAutoRows: minmax(<row>, auto), never a bare length
clampsNotExpressibleHere.note: These constrain the composition and the emitted markup rather than the value of a knob, so scripts/assign-spans.mjs and ui-morphism-core:a11y-validate enforce them. Recorded here so the clamp table reads as the complete list.
